final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.region AS region, s1.avg_amt AS avg_amt, s1.cnt AS cnt, s1.avg_amt - s2.m AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.avg_amt > s2.m) SELECT AVG(avg_amt), AVG(cnt), AVG(diff) FROM s3
